sources.title: Ornith-1.0: Self-Scaffolding LLMs for Agentic Coding
sources.evidence: June 2026 announcement explicitly includes a 31B Dense member of Ornith-1.0, a family intended for agentic coding and trained with joint scaffold/solution optimization. The current page reports results only for 9B, 35B and 397B. Reopened October 27: the nominal 31B Dense announcement remains; the family is described as built on Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5, without a separate 31B active specification.

sources.title: Original Ornith-1 README at June 25, 2026 commit
sources.evidence: Original developer README explicitly lists 31B-Dense with the other Ornith-1.0 variants and states MIT licensing. Citation credits DeepReinforce Team. Detailed reasoning, context and tool-serving examples concern Ornith-1.0-9B, not 31B. Fresh October 27 retrieval of the pinned original README confirms that 31B nominal announcement and family-level post-training lineage; no separate active count is stated.

sources.title: Current official Ornith repository README
sources.evidence: Current checkpoint table lists only 9B, 35B and 397B for Ornith-1.0. Its 262144-token context and reasoning/tool-parser documentation describes shipped checkpoints; 31B has no row or serving recipe. Both generations are described as MIT licensed. Reopened October 27: both generation checkpoint tables still list 9B, 35B and 397B without a 31B row.

sources.title: Official Ornith-1.0 weights collection
sources.evidence: Collection linked directly from the developer announcement contains 9B, 35B and 397B checkpoints and quantizations, with no 31B checkpoint at review time.

sources.title: Official organization public model listing
sources.evidence: Live public organization listing contains no Ornith-1.0-31B. The old deepreinforce-ai organization query and an exact Ornith-1.0-31B search returned empty arrays. Absence does not prove the model never existed. Fresh October 27 organization listing again contains no exact 31B checkpoint; newer Ornith-1.5-122B entries do not establish a 31B specification.

sources.title: Exact 31B model metadata endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Exact new-organization metadata endpoint returned HTTP 401; the deepreinforce-ai equivalent also returned 401. No exact-model metadata or public model card was obtained. Fresh October 27 exact ornith-ai metadata request again returned HTTP 401.

sources.title: Exact 31B configuration endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. Configuration and exact learned architecture dimensions could not be inspected.

sources.title: Exact 31B tensor index endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. No shard filenames or tensor headers were available, so complete learned-weight counting and buffer/quantization checks were impossible; no weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.evidence: Later first-party article covers 9B, 35B and 397B and compares their Ornith-1.0 versions. It contains no Ornith-1.0-31B total/active parameter table or new 31B specification; Gemma4-31B comparison entries refer to a different model. Reopened October 27 and inspected the full model comparisons: the active A3B label is attached to 35B, while Gemma4-31B is a comparator rather than a new Ornith 31B specification.

sources.title: Official repository README history
sources.evidence: The README announcing the family including 31B was committed on June 25, 2026 (16d32b11211ac83373d37dc67234f77e77f909a1). This dates the announcement text, not a demonstrated public 31B weight release.

sources.title: Gemma 4 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete report freshly fetched October 27, including Table 1, architecture section and comparison headings. It specifies dense 31B size/component totals and separately labels 3.8B activated parameters for the 26B-A4B MoE. It does not supply a dense Gemma 31B active-count convention to transfer, nor an exact Ornith checkpoint relationship.

sources.title: Gemma 4 model card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the current model card: the dense 31B table labels 30.7B as Total Parameters and lists a separate roughly 550M vision encoder. Only the MoE table labels Active Parameters, at 3.8B. These distinctions do not establish an Ornith 31B active count; the existing nominal Ornith total is retained from its own announcement.

sources.title: Ornith 1.0 VRAM Requirements: Complete Quantization Guide
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model active-count search found and read this July guide. It assigns Ornith-1.0-31B 31B active parameters per token and a Gemma 4 base, without a field-level developer derivation. Its footer explicitly disclaims affiliation with DeepReinforce. Its claim of four public checkpoints also conflicts with the current official listing. Recorded as an uncorroborated lead, not a verified specification.

sources.title: Ornith official distribution and serving instructions
sources.evidence: Fresh developer README links public checkpoints for the 9B, 35B and 397B lines and its current serving table lists these sizes. No 1.0 31B download appears, despite earlier family-level open-source and MIT announcements.

sources.title: Ornith official public weight inventory
sources.evidence: Fresh inventory returned 36 public repositories across 1.0 and 1.5, including 1.0 9B, 35B and 397B and quantizations, but no 1.0 31B checkpoint.

sources.title: Exact Ornith 1.0 31B repository check
sources.evidence: Fresh exact metadata request returned HTTP 401. This failure does not independently prove nonexistence; the official public inventory and distribution instructions also supply no public 31B download.

developer.note: Original README credits DeepReinforce Team; the current repository and model organization are branded Ornith.

family.note: Explicit member of the Ornith-1.0 family.

release_date.note: Developer-announced release date: the June 25 README says the family is releasing today and explicitly lists 31B as available. Retain this last-documented announcement date despite current availability uncertainty; it does not prove a 31B checkpoint was downloadable.

open_weights.note: Closed under the user-requested practical availability rule: no public downloadable Ornith 1.0 31B checkpoint was located. Current developer distribution instructions and complete public model inventory publish other sizes but omit 31B; the exact repository request is inaccessible. Preserve the original MIT/open-family announcement as separate licensing/history evidence. Closed here means no verified public download, not proprietary ownership or a claim that the announcement never occurred.

license.note: Developer announces MIT for the family while explicitly including 31B. This is the announced license; no 31B checkpoint license file was available.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 original announcement and pinned release README confirm the developer-published nominal 31B total. Preserve that published precision despite the unavailable exact checkpoint; a tensor census is not required to support the announcement.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches and original/later primary comparisons yield no separately defined active count. The announced Gemma 4/Qwen 3.5 family lineage does not supply a count-bearing exact base; Google’s dense 31B totals are not labeled active. The unofficial 31B-active guide lacks a developer derivation. Dense classification alone does not establish this field.

architecture.note: Explicitly announced as 31B Dense. Exact layer structure and Transformer implementation remain unverified without a model card/configuration; no sibling specification is transferred.

context_window.note: 262144 tokens is documented for shipped checkpoints; 31B is absent from their table, and its configuration is inaccessible. Clear the unsupported exact-variant baseline.

modalities.note: The developer announcement identifies this variant as a language model for generating coding solutions from tasks, supporting text input/output. Image support is not established for the exact 31B variant and is removed; no sibling visual processor is assumed.

reasoning.note: Reasoning-parser recipes apply to documented shipped models. No exact 31B card or template establishes a dedicated thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Agentic-coding intent alone does not establish a native tool-call serialization/interface for the absent 31B checkpoint.

description.value: Announced 31B dense Ornith 1.0 variant for agentic coding; public checkpoint availability remains unverified.

sources.label: Ornith official distribution and serving instructions

patch.notes: 31B is the developer-announced nominal total; active parameters are not separately disclosed. June 25, 2026 is the announced release date, with MIT licensing. No public 31B checkpoint was found: current official distribution lists omit it and its metadata endpoint is inaccessible. Context, image input, dedicated thinking and native tool calling remain unverified for this variant. Classified closed for current public-download availability; the announced MIT license is preserved.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained the published nominal 31B total and an undisclosed active count. Reopened original and current developer evidence, reran exact-model total/active/lineage searches, checked later Ornith comparisons and the Gemma 4 report/card, and documented an unsupported independent 31B-active claim. Added explicit parameter patches and preserved unrelated assessments; no weight shards or repeat census requested. October 28 availability review: Classified closed for current public-download availability; the announced MIT license is preserved. All thirteen unrelated field assessments and prior research metadata are preserved.

availability_resolution.classification_rule: Open means an identified public downloadable checkpoint for this exact model or a developer-documented equivalent; otherwise closed under the user-requested practical availability rule. This is not a legal ownership or perpetual-closure finding.
